# St. Aloysius' College, Galle

> Official website of St. Aloysius' College, Galle, Sri Lanka - a Catholic boys'
> college founded in 1895 by Belgian Jesuit missionaries under Bishop Joseph
> Van Reeth. Motto: Certa Viriliter ("Strive Manfully"). Pages are server-rendered
> HTML; every public page carries schema.org JSON-LD (EducationalOrganization /
> School, WebSite, BreadcrumbList) and a canonical URL on https://aloysiuscollege.lk
> (no `www`, no trailing slash).

## Pages

- [Home](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/): overview, principal's message, latest news, exam results highlights, gallery
- [About](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/about): history from 1895, founders, vision and mission, administration, principal's message
- [Academics](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/academics): sections of study, G.C.E. A/L streams, departments, academic leadership, facilities
- [Examinations & Results](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/results): G.C.E. O/L and A/L results, Grade 5 scholarship results, top rankers
- [Student Life](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/students): clubs and societies, sports, events, achievements
- [News & Events](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/news): announcements, news articles, upcoming events
- [Alumni](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/alumni): the Old Boys' Association, branches, distinguished Aloysians
- [Media](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/media): photo galleries and media links
- [Galleries](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/galleries): index of published photo galleries; each gallery lives at `/galleries/<slug>`
- [Contact](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/contact): College office address, telephone, email, department directory, map

## Key facts

- Name: St. Aloysius' College, Galle
- Founded: 1895
- Type: Catholic boys' college, Primary through G.C.E. Advanced Level
- Location: Templers' Road, Kaluwella, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
- Telephone: +94 91 223 4657
- Email: info@aloysiuscollege.lk
- Motto: Certa Viriliter (Strive Manfully)
- A/L streams: Physical Science, Biological Science, Commerce, Arts & Technology

## Other College sites

- [Admissions](https://admissions.aloysiuscollege.lk/): applications and enrolment (a separate site, not a path on this one)
- [Management portal](https://mgmt.aloysiuscollege.lk/): the College's management system (staff and students)

## Machine-readable data

- [Sitemap](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/sitemap.xml): every public URL with last-modified dates (`/sitemaps.xml` redirects here)
- [robots.txt](https://aloysiuscollege.lk/robots.txt): crawling is open to search and AI crawlers; staff areas (/admin, /cms, /club-admin, /sign-in, /preview) are excluded

## Optional

- Photos on the site are served from `/api/files/<key>` and are public.
- Staff areas are not public and carry no indexable content.
